scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fiestapay/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @fiestapay/api" "npm run dev -w @fiestapay/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fiestapay/shared && npm run build -w @fiestapay/api && npm run build -w @fiestapay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fiestapay/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
